newsitem.title: USA: Isidore, in North Atlantic, now a tropical storm.
newsitem.headline: Isidore, in North Atlantic, now a tropical storm.

text.p: Isidore was downgraded to a tropical storm on Sunday as its maximum winds dropped to 70 mph (110 kph) over the cooler waters of the North Atlantic, the National Hurricane Centre said.
At 5 p.m. EDT (2100 GMT), the centre of Isidore was at latitude 22.8 north, longitude 40.5 west, about 1,300 miles (2,100 km) south-southwest of the Azores and moving northeast at 12 mph (19 kph).
Maximum sustained winds dropped below the hurricane threshold of 75 mph (120 kph) on Sunday, and forecasters said the storm would probably continue to lose strength through Monday.
Isidore's track seemed likely to keep it away from the U.S. East Coast and Bermuda, the British island territory that lies well to the east of the North Carolina coast.
